text: For the postmortem: what time did I first report the kiosks offline on 3 Aug, and what was the guard doing in the meantime?
reply_text: @gideon.sato: your first report in #inc-vtg-hartford was at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug, when you wrote that the gate kiosks were offline at the Hartford plant.
